thread:
Maya (CSM): Heads up — Veridian is asking to split the renewal invoices across their US and EU entities and push a 9mo term instead of 12. They also want onboarding to start after invoice is issued. Any quick blockers?
Liam (Finance): For split invoices we need both vendor codes and tax IDs. Do we have the EU entity tax id?
Maya (CSM): Not yet, customer said they'll provide tomorrow. They asked if we can accept a single PO that lists two billing entities.
Priya (Legal): Single PO can work if both entities are listed and contract references the correct legal entity. Need to confirm which legal entity is signing — signer mismatch is a common blocker.
Diego (Onboarding): If onboarding waits until invoice, timelines shift. We have a 2-week prep window. If invoice date moves out, onboarding start date slides accordingly. 
Maya (CSM): They also want Dedicated capacity enabled for the first month (HIPAA partner). That needs a Dedicated addendum, right?
Priya (Legal): Yes — Dedicated/Private deployments require the Dedicated Addendum + KMS/HIPAA clause. That alters signature path; legal needs to swap contract template.
Liam (Finance): From billing side: request to accept CC for the EU entity isn't allowed due to corporate policy. EU must wire or use their AP. So PO or wire only.
Maya (CSM): Customer asked if we can prorate 9mo pricing based on their current committed seats.
Diego (Onboarding): Also need to know if they expect live SSO and SCIM before go-live. That affects onboarding scope and effort estimate.
Maya (CSM): Quick ask — can contracts-bot generate a draft with: 9mo term, split invoices clause, Dedicated addendum placeholder, AND clause that onboarding starts upon invoice issuance?
contracts-bot: Draft generation queued. Template: renewal_9mo_split_billing.draft (internal preview link: https://internal.redwood/drafts/renewal_9mo_split_billing/1762123456)
Priya (Legal): I'll pull the Dedicated addendum and mark the signer-entity field as required. Once customer provides tax ids and signer name we can finalize.
Liam (Finance): Vendor codes: US -> VC-4491, EU -> pending. If they give VAT ID today I can provision the EU vendor code by EOD tomorrow.
Maya (CSM): I'll ask the customer to provide VAT + signer by EOD. Also confirming they will not require invoice to be sent to a 3rd party procurement platform (they said possibly Coupa).
Diego (Onboarding): If they require Coupa integration, onboarding timeline + scope increase by ~3 days for PO processing, but not a showstopper.
Maya (CSM): Great — action items: 1) me: request VAT + signer + Coupa confirmation; 2) Liam: provision EU vendor code once VAT provided; 3) Priya: prep Dedicated addendum and update draft; 4) Diego: estimate updated onboarding timeline if Coupa/SSO needed.
Liam (Finance): Noted. Also, flag: if they want CC fallback for the US entity we can do it, but prefer wired payment for record keeping.
Priya (Legal): FYI — if signer is not a board-level exec, need delegated signer evidence (email from primary signatory).
Maya (CSM): I'll get delegated signer evidence if needed. I'll circle back by EOD with customer responses. :thumbsup:
Diego (Onboarding): Thanks — I'll pencil in a tentative start 2 weeks after invoice issuance and update as we get Coupa/SSO details.
Maya (CSM): Closing loop — customer confirmed VAT + signer name via email. Sending to Liam and Priya now.
Liam (Finance): Received VAT, provisioning EU vendor code now. ETA: 24h.
Priya (Legal): Received signer name — running delegation check. If all good I'll approve the draft for signatures.
contracts-bot: Draft updated: renewal_9mo_split_billing_v2 (link: https://internal.redwood/drafts/renewal_9mo_split_billing_v2/1762123456)
Maya (CSM): Quick note for SRE: Dedicated capacity will be requested for month 1 only. I'll file the infra request after signatures.
Diego (Onboarding): Copy — once finance confirms invoice issuance date I'll lock the onboarding kickoff and send calendar invites.
Maya (CSM): Thanks team. Will update thread once we have signed docs. :party_parrot:
